engPnRf: Which sentence uses a reflexive pronoun?

The mayor cut the ribbon for him.

Yourself only emphasizes you, so it is intensive.

Which sentence uses an intensive pronoun?

Which sentence uses a reflexive pronoun?

Intensive, because it is the object of help

ourselves
ourself
themselves
us

himself
